title: Fix FIPS 140 checksum validation failure
description:
[SRU] Backport FIPS 140 checksum fix to Jammy

This fix excludes the bundled FIPS 140 snapshot ZIPs from dh_strip_nondeterminism to preserve the certified upstream checksums. This aligns the golang-1.24 package in Jammy with the fix already merged for golang-1.27.

Original approved MP for sponsor context: https://code.launchpad.net/~sumit-tiwari/ubuntu/+source/golang-1.27/+git/golang-1.27/+merge/514448
commit_message:
Fix FIPS 140 checksum validation failure

LP: #2174698
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index 2d8b9c1..ed1d786 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,10 @@
+golang-1.24 (1.24.13-2~22.04.2ubuntu1) jammy; urgency=medium
+
+  * d/rules: Exclude native fips140 module zips from dh_strip_nondeterminism 
+    to preserve upstream checksums and fix Go 1.24 validation (LP: #2174698).
+
+ -- Sumit Tiwari <sumit.tiwari@canonical.com>  Wed, 18 Nov 2026 16:55:23 +0530
+
 golang-1.24 (1.24.13-2~22.04.2) jammy-security; urgency=medium
 
   * SECURITY UPDATE: Privilege Escalation
diff --git a/debian/rules b/debian/rules
index 52fb466..01a8f98 100755
--- a/debian/rules
+++ b/debian/rules
@@ -92,7 +92,8 @@ override_dh_strip:
 override_dh_dwz:
 
 override_dh_strip_nondeterminism:
-	dh_strip_nondeterminism -Xtestdata
+	dh_strip_nondeterminism -Xtestdata \
+	--exclude=usr/share/go-$(GOVER)/lib/fips140/*.zip
 
 override_dh_shlibdeps:
 	dh_shlibdeps -Xtestdata -Xtest
